title: FailurePayload
description: Artifact emitted when a deterministic workflow execution times out or fails while targeting a selector. The backend healer consumes this payload and does not require runner internals.

workflow_id.description: Workflow that failed. Must match SelectorMap.workflow_id.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds when the failure was recorded.

failed_step.description: Semantic field or step name that did not resolve, matching a key in SelectorMap.fields when the failure is a selector miss.

expected_selector.description: CSS selector the runner waited on.

page_url.description: URL of the page at the moment of failure.

dom_snippet.description: HTML fragment around the expected target, including shifted or broken markup the healer can compare.

screenshot_path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute path to the failure screenshot. Path only; the image bytes are not part of this contract.

error_message.description: Human-readable failure reason, including timeout and the selector that was not found.
